description: For one credit-market event (an id from get_events; without one, the newest events to choose from): its sentence, the link to post (X shows it as a card with the event's chart), the suggested chart and other series to set beside it (each with a page that saves it as a PNG to attach), and the rules a post follows. The assistant drafts the post from these; nothing is posted by this server. A post stays descriptive: the event's figures and dates, no forecast, no advice, no ranking and no cause the data does not state; the rules give X's length limit and how a link counts against it.
name: get_event_post_kit
title: What to post an event on X with (text, link, chart)
